top_findings.title: GET /books emits malformed JSON — isbn string unterminated in list path (FEEDBACK regression NOT fixed)
top_findings.evidence: src/handler.cpp:228 `<< jsonEscape(book.isbn) << "}";` closes each list element with `}` instead of `\"}` — the isbn value opens with a quote (`\"isbn\": \"`) but never closes it, so every element is `..."isbn": "VALUE}` (invalid JSON). The single-book paths use the correct `\"}`: POST src/handler.cpp:210, PUT src/handler.cpp:258, GET-by-id src/handler.cpp:281. FEEDBACK.md:22 explicitly named this exact bug ('GET /books emits malformed JSON — isbn string is unterminated'); the repair did not fix the list path.
top_findings.suggestion: Change line 228 to `<< jsonEscape(book.isbn) << "\"}";` to match the single-book serializers.

top_findings.title: Validation errors return HTTP 200 instead of 400 — create without title/author not rejected with correct status
top_findings.evidence: Validation runs and blocks persistence (src/handler.cpp:189-200: BookValidator::validate fails, returns `{"errors": [{"field":..,"message":..}]}` without calling db_.createBook). But the server's status inference success-branch matches any body containing `"message":` (src/server.cpp:182), and the error body contains `"message":` — so status_code is set to 200, never 400 (src/server.cpp:174-193). R9's how_to_verify requires 'rejected (400)'. Validation logic exists (src/model.cpp:4-30) but the HTTP status is wrong.
top_findings.suggestion: In the default handler, detect the `{"errors":` shape (or have the handler signal a status) and map it to 400 BEFORE the generic `"message":`→200 check in src/server.cpp:178-193.
